KFAC.description: Effective Length Factor (KFAC). Holds the member effective length factors used in PSC rating; all fields are optional and default to 1.0. Kt is excluded from the PSC schema.

Ky.description: Effective length factor about the member y-axis. Stored as BKy.

Kz.description: Effective length factor about the member z-axis. Stored as BKz.
